flyer.justification: The flyer captures the main themes well but violates the instruction specifying a title of at most 6 words.

linkedin.justification: The post adheres to all LinkedIn format constraints, avoiding banned buzzwords and presenting core talk takeaways clearly.

instagram.justification: The caption meets all formatting requirements, including slide cues, emojis, call to action, and exactly 10 targeted hashtags.

summary.justification: The briefing is well within the 400-word limit and clearly outlines the TL;DR, evidence, discussion points, and action items.

newsletter.justification: The newsletter body is fluent and properly organized into three sections, but the subject line exceeds the 50-character limit.

blog.justification: The long-form article follows all structural guidelines, including numbered sections, a takeaway table, and an About the Author section.
